system.description: Needs the Vengeance's Mark world script (see the Homebrew Setup journal).
system.positive: At the start of the round after the first, if there is no [[/status Vengeance's Mark]], the character who dealt the most damage to your allies in the previous round gains [[/status Vengeance's Mark]].
system.easyEffects:
[Start of Round]
require hasFlag "vengeance_on" combat == 0 then
  set flag "vengeance_on" on combat to 1 and
  set flag "vengeance_best" on combat to 0 and
  set flag "vengeance_best_id" on combat to "none" and
  set flag "vengeance_best_round" on combat to 0 and
  set flag "vengeance_recount" on combat to 0 and
  set flag "vengeance_recount_id" on combat to "none" and
  set flag "vengeance_recount_for" on combat to "none";
set flag "vengeance_side" on self to 1;
proc "Vengeance Side" on allies;
